name: gnome-timezones-extension
description: Show multiple clock timezones in the panel
author: Masquerade <christian@masquerade-circus.net>

scripts.zip: rm -f timezones@dustin-hawkins.zip && zip -r timezones@dustin-hawkins.zip extension.js timezones.js metadata.json schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.dustin-hawkins-timezones.gschema.xml
scripts.install:local: npm run zip && gnome-extensions install --force timezones@dustin-hawkins.zip
